mageHello1.say: Something sealed? Put it here. Gently.

mageHello2.say: The sea gives things up when it chooses. Let's see what it chose.

mageHello3.say: No two are sealed the same way. I'd give a lot to know why.

mageHello4.say: Some of them come in warm. That never stops being strange.

mageThanks1.say: There. Not what I expected. They never are.

mageThanks2.say: Open. Strange, the things the water keeps for us.

mageThanks3.say: Hm. That one was older than it looked. Take it.

vaultkeeperHello1.say: Your things are where you left them. I counted.

vaultkeeperHello2.say: Leave what you cannot carry. I keep it dry.

vaultkeeperHello3.say: Salt gets into everything in Overlook but this vault.

vaultkeeperHello4.say: Counted twice this morning. Everything balanced. It always does, here.

armorsmithHello1.say: Armour, fitted here. Tell me where the last lot let you down.

armorsmithHello2.say: Fresh plate on the rack today. Go on, knock on it.

armorsmithHello3.say: Wear it, don't admire it. Nothing out there cares how you look.

armorsmithHello4.say: Back again? Show me the dents. The dents tell me everything.

armorsmithThanks2.say: Good. Bring it back dented, not empty.

armorsmithShort1.say: You're short. Steel isn't cheap, not with the Tithe on the water.

weaponsmithHello1.say: Blades, bows, guns. Something sharp for whatever the sea sends up.

weaponsmithHello2.say: Tithe took another ship last night, I hear. Take something that bites back.

weaponsmithHello3.say: Every one of these is tested. Mostly on driftwood.

weaponsmithHello4.say: Don't touch the edge. Everybody touches the edge.

weaponsmithThanks1.say: Keep it oiled. Salt eats everything.

weaponsmithThanks2.say: Good. Bring it back if it bends.

weaponsmithShort1.say: You're short. Bring the rest and it's yours.

tailorHello1.say: Ah, someone who cares how they look. Rare, in Overlook.

tailorHello2.say: I mix every colour by my own hand. Nobody else here bothers.

tailorHello3.say: Salt fades everything. My dyes fade last. Ask anyone worth asking.

tailorHello4.say: That colour you're wearing. No. We can fix it.

tailorThanks1.say: You'll be the best dressed on the harbour. After me.

tailorThanks2.say: Wear it well. People will ask where you found it.

tailorShort1.say: Beauty costs, I'm afraid. Rather more than you're carrying.

tackHello1.say: Bring your horse round sometime. I've something for every coat.

tackHello2.say: Horses hate the salt as much as we do. Be kind to yours.

tackHello3.say: Good barding keeps the spray off. A pretty one keeps their spirits up.

tackHello4.say: Mind the grey. She bites, but only people she likes.

tackThanks1.say: There. Mind the girth on the first ride.

tackThanks2.say: Lovely. Give them an apple from me.

tackShort1.say: Not quite enough, love. The horse can wait a day.

stormcallerHello1.say: Quick now, what do you need? The weather's turning.

stormcallerHello2.say: You look like someone who hates standing still. Good.

stormcallerHello3.say: Make it quick. The clouds are building.

stormcallerHello4.say: Smell that? Rain by nightfall. Talk fast.

stormcallerThanks1.say: Done. Go, before the wind changes.

stormcallerShort1.say: Not enough. Come back quicker, and with more.

marenHello1.say: Sit a while, child. The lamps will keep.

marenHello2.say: Three ports still stand. We keep our lamps lit all the same.

marenHello3.say: Overlook remembers things its own way. I remember them slowly.

marenHello4.say: Ask three people who built the Beacon, and you'll hear four names.

marenThanks1.say: There. May it light your way home.

marenThanks2.say: Look after it, and it will outlast us both.

marenShort1.say: Not yet, dear. Come back when you can. I'll be here.

shapeHello1.say: You came. The sea said you would.

shapeHello3.say: I was here before. You do not remember. No one does.

shapeHello4.say: Same as last time. You do not remember last time.

postmasterHello1.say: Whatever you leave lying out there ends up here. I sort it.

postmasterHello2.say: The sea gives back what you drop. To me, mostly.

postmasterHello3.say: Nothing posted here goes missing. I would know.

postmasterHello4.say: Mind the parcels. Half of them are still damp.

postmasterThanks1.say: Signed for. Try to keep hold of it this time.

postmasterThanks2.say: There. One less parcel on my shelves.
